description: This Java class 'BasicMapperUtils' provides utility methods for mapping OAuth2 user attributes, including constructing user objects and extracting tenant names based on different strategies.

classes.name: BasicMapperUtils
classes.description: Utility class for mapping OAuth2 user attributes and tenant names based on configuration.

methods.name: getOAuth2User
methods.description: Constructs an OAuth2User object from email, attributes, and configuration, setting properties like name, tenant, customer name, and dashboard.

methods.name: getTenantName
methods.description: Determines tenant name based on email and configuration strategy (EMAIL, DOMAIN, or CUSTOM).

methods.name: getStringAttributeByKey
methods.description: Retrieves a string attribute from a map by key, with error handling and logging.
